original_target.title: Large-data global smoothness for the spatially inhomogeneous Boltzmann equation

scope_comparison: OpenAI's October periodic hard-sphere nonuniqueness uses a nonnegative datum with unbounded amplitudes at shrinking spatial scales and bounded velocity support. It violates the target's smooth strictly positive Gaussian-lower-bound assumptions. Scattering Theory Theorem1 assumes an existing Maxwellian-bounded mild solution on its lifespan; it does not establish arbitrary-data global smooth existence on T3. Weak entropy nonuniqueness is not smooth-class nonuniqueness.
